literature_notes: All five ledger lines (L1–L5) describe C-terminal tags on full-length, membrane-anchored ADAM12. L1 reports ADAM12-GFP (C-terminal GFP fusion); L2 reports ADAM12-myc-His constructed by ligation into pcDNA3.1/myc-His, which appends the tag after the last coding residue; L3 reports co-localization of the GFP-tagged WT and myc-tagged L792F constructs — the same constructs as L1/L2, adding no new junction; L4 reports ADAM12-pcDNA6-myc (another C-terminal myc); L5 validates expression of the L4 construct by siRNA knockdown. The authoritative topology places the ADAM12 C-terminus at residue 909 within the intracellular domain (730–909), which begins immediately after the TM helix (709–729). No ledger line reports a tag at the extracellular N-terminus (mature residue 29 onward), within the large ectodomain (29–708), or at any internal extracellular loop. Because the ledger contains no insertion on the extracellular face, zero surface-tag sites are proposed. The intracellular C-terminal junction (after residue 909) is recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal GFP fusion (L1) and myc-His fusion (L2) both append tags after the last residue (K909); the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (730–909), not on the extracellular surface.
